name: Algorithmic Trace Disguise
description: Replace the algebraic edge constraint with a short, deterministic algorithm (Fibonacci modulo 4) that evaluates to true if and only if the two inputs are different. LLMs excel at simplifying algebraic expressions but struggle to invert or analytically simplify procedural loops, preventing them from recognizing the underlying graph-coloring structure and forcing them to rely on the unoptimized simulation of the loop.
